description: Gigaverse has built a fundamental platform that helps gig workers and drivers plan, save and file taxes, and retire through AI-powered advisory. Gigaverse is free for partners, their clients, and users. The PRActicle™ portable Roth IRA and other IRA products are waitlist-only and are not open to consumers. Agents can help a person join the waitlist. They cannot open an account. Educational only.
